name: 苔芽兽
visual: a squat lime moss mammal with a large sprouting seed head and four pebble feet
lore: 把背上的幼苗栽在干裂的脚印中，让后来者有柔软的落脚处。

name: 烬尾狐
visual: a slender orange fox with a single charcoal brush tail glowing at the tip
lore: 尾尖只在奔跑后亮起，会用余温替夜行者烘干衣角。

name: 泡鳍灵
visual: an upright sky blue axolotl with bubble gills and transparent sail fins
lore: 将空气藏在鳃边的泡膜中，带迷路的小虫穿过浅水。

name: 灯蕨鹿
visual: a small ivory deer with branching green luminous fern antlers
lore: 鹿角上的蕨叶每晚轮流发亮，花开前会绕着湿地巡视。

name: 焰盔蟹
visual: a broad red hermit crab wearing an obsidian volcanic furnace shell
lore: 以熔岩冷却后的空腔为壳，蜕壳时会留下能避雨的小屋。

name: 雾铃鲸
visual: a floating violet miniature whale with a brass bell under its chin
lore: 下颌的钟不靠撞击发声，而会在雾变浓时随呼吸鸣响。

name: 冠苔鸮
visual: a round green owl wearing a crown of moss and broad striped wings
lore: 会用不同的敲木节奏记录林路，最古老的树洞是它的乐谱。

name: 曜羽雀
visual: a tiny gold sunbird with a radiant fan of ember feather rays
lore: 每日只捡一根折断的羽毛，用它修补向阳崖壁上的巢。

name: 星潮龙
visual: a long cobalt seahorse dragon with a constellation pattern and fin crest
lore: 用背鳍感受海底暗流，星光在鳞片上连成归航的线路。

name: 露盏蜗
visual: a teal snail carrying a giant dew filled lotus cup instead of shell
lore: 清晨把露水分给石缝里的幼草，杯口的水线记录了夜雨。

name: 砂炉獾
visual: a stout ochre badger with a ceramic kiln belly and shovel claws
lore: 会把潮湿的细沙拍成小碗，放在腹炉旁慢慢烘干。

name: 珊枝海马
visual: a curled pink seahorse with asymmetric coral branches and spiral tail
lore: 一生只守护一簇珊瑚，枝角断裂后会成为新的珊瑚苗床。

name: 月桂螳
visual: an elegant mint praying mantis with laurel leaf scythes and crescent head
lore: 以月桂叶遮住锋利的前肢，只剪掉被盐霜压坏的枝条。

name: 琥珀蝎
visual: a transparent amber scorpion containing a glowing fossil seed
lore: 尾针分泌的树脂会封存落叶，透过甲壳能看见去年春天的种子。

name: 云帆水母
visual: a pale blue jellyfish with a triangular cloud sail and ribbon tentacles
lore: 帆顶朝向风来的方向，渔人根据它的漂移决定何时收网。

name: 铃叶螽
visual: a leaf green katydid with bronze bell shaped knees and long antennae
lore: 后腿轻碰就会奏出两种音高，雨前总是先停下合奏。

name: 流萤狸
visual: a dark indigo raccoon with a lantern firefly abdomen and striped tail
lore: 会把发光的腹部藏在落叶下，为夜里孵化的飞蛾指路。

name: 星礁鳐
visual: a diamond shaped midnight manta ray covered with rose crystal reefs
lore: 身体像一座缓慢迁徙的小礁，晶簇只在清澈的水中长出新棱。

name: 蒲风鼠
visual: a cream jerboa with huge round ears and a dandelion parachute tail
lore: 尾端的蒲公英只会顺风张开，带着种子跃过岛间的窄沟。

name: 赤索蛇
visual: a scarlet rope snake with a glowing knot shaped crest and no limbs
lore: 把身体盘成松软的结，替在寒夜里赶路的甲虫挡住冷风。

name: 丝带乌贼
visual: a white squid with long turquoise ribbon arms and ink calligraphy spots
lore: 墨汁遇海水会变成淡蓝，短暂留下它刚游过的水道。

name: 缎足蛛
visual: a violet jumping spider with six visible silk spindles and silk slipper feet
lore: 会把沾湿的网收成一团，再拆成八只不会打滑的小鞋。

name: 缆锚龟
visual: a small iron grey turtle with anchor shaped shell and thick rope tail
lore: 休息时把锚尾扎进泥里，任凭潮水涨落也不挪动分毫。

name: 游丝海兔
visual: a peach sea slug with long ribbon ear rhinophores and a ruffled skirt
lore: 在退潮的水洼里拖出发亮的游丝，让同伴知道哪里还有水。

name: 扇藻蝠
visual: a flat leaf green bat with enormous kelp fan wings and tiny body
lore: 翅膜上的孔洞让海风发出和声，它会挑最安静的洞窟过冬。

name: 金缕蜂
visual: a golden bumblebee with spool shaped abdomen and silk thread legs
lore: 把金色的巢丝系在花梗之间，暴风来时整片花田会一同低头。

name: 飘旗鲤
visual: a white koi fish with red pennant fins and a floating streamer tail
lore: 鳍边像飘扬的小旗，遇到逆流便把长尾折成一道浪。

name: 伞菌貘
visual: a lilac tapir with a huge red spotted mushroom umbrella on its back
lore: 用长鼻翻松雨后的泥土，背上的菌伞为幼苗留下阴凉。

name: 烛芯蚁
visual: a black ant with a tall wax candle abdomen and tiny living flame
lore: 熄灯时会把火苗藏进蜡壳，一队同行就像移动的夜灯。

name: 珠冠蚌
visual: an open ivory clam with pearl eyes and an ornate aqua shell crown
lore: 闭壳前会先把误入的小鱼送出去，珍珠因此很少完全圆整。

name: 晶簇犀
visual: a low broad grey rhinoceros with a clustered emerald crystal horn
lore: 用晶角磨平山路的尖石，角上的划痕记录着整座岛的斜坡。

name: 冠轮甲虫
visual: a burgundy stag beetle with a circular crown wheel horn
lore: 角轮可以卡住滚动的果实，常把最大的一个留在树根旁。

name: 冰盏企鹅
visual: a pudgy blue penguin carrying a frosted bowl shaped ice collar
lore: 颈边冰盏储存着融雪，口渴时只取最靠外的一层。

name: 莲台蛙
visual: a green bullfrog sitting inside its own enormous pink lotus collar
lore: 鸣叫时花领会一片片展开，池塘的回声能让它辨出远处的雨。

name: 花火孔雀
visual: a tiny dark peacock with a semicircle of firework spark eye feathers
lore: 求偶的尾屏只持续一次心跳，落下的火星不会烫伤青草。

name: 陨冠蜥
visual: a chunky purple gecko wearing a meteorite crown and star toe pads
lore: 脚趾能牢牢吸住陡壁，夜里会趴在陨石上等待还未落下的星。

name: 根须鼹
visual: a blind brown mole with a tangled root beard and pink spade hands
lore: 不用眼睛就能分辨树根的渴意，挖出的隧道总通向干燥的地方。

name: 熔灯鳗
visual: a long lava orange eel with one hanging glowing furnace lure
lore: 潜伏在温泉出口，额前的灯会随着水温改变明暗。

name: 漩眼螺
visual: a blue spiral nautilus with one big lens eye and curled tentacles
lore: 透过螺壳中央的镜眼看世界，能在混浊海水中找到一根细针。

name: 藤盾螽
visual: a green walking stick insect with a round vine shield on its forearms
lore: 遇险时把藤盾挡在更小的虫子前面，宁可少吃一口嫩叶。

name: 铆甲犰狳
visual: a rust colored armadillo with riveted overlapping metal scales
lore: 收集沉船上的铆钉压进鳞缝，卷起时像一颗旧船上的铁球。

name: 须瀑鲶
visual: a pale teal catfish with long flowing waterfall moustache fins
lore: 长须会挂住淡水凝成的水珠，洪水退后把它们送回浅溪。

name: 绒雪蛾
visual: a white fluffy moth with snowflake antennae and ice blue velvet wings
lore: 翅粉像细雪却不会融化，能替刚破壳的幼虫挡住急雨。

name: 鬃焰马
visual: a miniature obsidian pony with a vertical flaming red mane
lore: 奔跑时鬃毛倒向来路，在昏暗山道上留下短暂的红光。

name: 盘须海龙
visual: a mustard leafy sea dragon with coiled whiskers and featherlike fins
lore: 每一圈胡须都握住一缕水流，静止时像扎根海底的水草。

name: 蜜囊熊
visual: a honey brown sun bear with a transparent golden honey pouch chest
lore: 从不搬走整座蜂巢，只带回巢口自然滴落的那一小口蜜。

name: 煤球刺猬
visual: a round charcoal hedgehog with ember tipped black spikes
lore: 白天蜷成不起眼的煤团，夜里替花园赶走怕热的啃叶虫。

name: 盐晶虾
visual: a translucent rose shrimp with large cubic salt crystals on its back
lore: 每次脱壳都留下一片盐晶，浅滩上的鸟儿靠它补充盐分。

name: 种荚袋鼠
visual: a small olive kangaroo with a seed pod pouch and leafy tail
lore: 育儿袋里装着尚未落土的种子，总等到听见雨声才把它们放下。

name: 鼓腹蟾
visual: a rust orange toad with a round tribal drum belly and short horns
lore: 腹部的皮膜只在涨潮时绷紧，鼓声能传到对岸的泥滩。

name: 泡壶章鱼
visual: a tiny aqua octopus with a ceramic teapot mantle and bubble spout
lore: 喜欢住进被海水磨圆的茶壶，喷出的泡泡带着海藻的清香。

name: 绒球兔
visual: a soft lavender angora rabbit with huge pompom ears and cotton tail
lore: 会把掉落的绒毛铺在同伴的巢口，自己却睡在最靠风的那一边。

name: 爆栗松鼠
visual: a red squirrel with a giant chestnut shell tail cracked with fire
lore: 尾壳会发出栗子爆开的脆响，能把偷藏在树皮下的坚果震下来。

name: 琉囊海星
visual: a five armed turquoise starfish with translucent floating glass sacs
lore: 囊中的空气随潮压缩放，让它像一盏缓缓升降的水灯。

name: 刺篱豪猪
visual: a moss green porcupine with a fence of living thorn branches
lore: 背上的刺会开出很小的白花，是林间不肯移动的边界标记。

name: 燧角牛
visual: a squat black bison with two flint horns sparking against each other
lore: 会用角撞碎崖口的落石，火花把潮湿的石壁照得一瞬明亮。

name: 冰叉枪鱼
visual: a silver marlin with a three pronged ice spear nose
lore: 长吻能把漂浮的碎冰拨开，为跟在身后的小鱼开出水路。

name: 棘叶蜥
visual: a sharp green lizard with serrated leaf dorsal plates and thorn tail
lore: 把苦涩的露水存在背棘之间，只有与它熟识的昆虫知道如何饮用。

name: 锯镰虾蛄
visual: a crimson mantis shrimp with enormous serrated crescent forearms
lore: 前臂的锯缘总朝外折叠，以免在拥挤的岩缝里划伤邻居。

name: 针毡海胆
visual: a purple sea urchin with knitted looking spines and a tiny white face
lore: 会把断掉的海草夹在针间，织成包住幼体的柔软外衣。

name: 箭羽鹭
visual: a long legged emerald heron with arrow shaped wing feathers
lore: 站立时会把一根箭羽垂到水面，以倒影判断猎物真正的位置。

name: 焰矛蜻蜓
visual: a long orange dragonfly with spear shaped abdomen and four flame glass wings
lore: 尾端亮起前会先绕水面一圈，留下细细的热雾。

name: 棱背剑鳗
visual: a flat cobalt ribbon eel with a long silver sword shaped dorsal edge
lore: 只在深水里展开锋利的背鳍，经过珊瑚群时会把身体折得很低。

name: 重岩河马
visual: a chunky slate hippo with a mossy boulder saddle and square muzzle
lore: 把背上的大石当作浅滩，让疲惫的水鸟暂时落脚。

name: 炭铠蜈蚣
visual: a curled black and orange centipede with chunky furnace armor segments
lore: 每节甲壳都储存一小股热气，经过湿地时会冒出一列白烟。

name: 冰盾海象
visual: a pale blue walrus with twin icicle tusks and huge shield cheeks
lore: 会用獠牙打碎困住小鱼的薄冰，随后用身躯挡住寒流。

name: 木桶象
visual: a miniature green elephant with a barrel shaped wooden body and leaf ears
lore: 鼻子卷起清水时，木纹里的裂隙会暂时闭合，像重新长好的树皮。

name: 铁砧独角仙
visual: a dark beetle with an anvil shaped horn and hammer forelegs
lore: 总在暴雨前敲响空树干，附近的虫群便知道该收起晾晒的食物。

name: 浮岛蝾
visual: a broad turquoise salamander with a tiny rocky island and pool on its back
lore: 背上的水洼与海潮相通，幼鱼会在里面度过最危险的几天。

name: 石面猿
visual: a small grey monkey with a carved moss stone mask and long knuckles
lore: 面具会随年龄变厚，每多一道裂纹就学会一种新的敲石声音。

name: 铜钟羊
visual: a golden copper ram with hollow bell spiral horns
lore: 两只空心角不会互相碰撞，却能在迎风时一起发出低鸣。

name: 玄壳鲎
visual: a deep indigo horseshoe crab with a huge star engraved shield shell
lore: 在沙中留下星形的爬痕，痕迹的方向总与下一次退潮一致。

name: 双瓣獭
visual: a brown river otter holding two huge green leaf paddles
lore: 会把两片落叶分给不同的同伴，再用拍水的节奏约定重逢。

name: 双芯火蛭
visual: a short crimson leech with two glowing furnace hearts visible inside
lore: 两颗火核轮流明灭，冬季会贴着冷却的岩石慢慢移动。

name: 双扇蝶鱼
visual: a turquoise butterfly fish with two enormous round fan fins
lore: 两面扇鳍能挡住同一束光，喜欢把幼鱼藏在自己的影子里。

name: 叉角锹虫
visual: an emerald stag beetle with a wide forked antler jaw
lore: 不爱争抢树汁，会用分叉的大颚把树皮撑开，等更小的甲虫先吃。

name: 双拳袋獾
visual: a rust red marsupial devil with oversized glowing boxing paws
lore: 拳套般的前爪平时只用来拍松土壤，巢穴里从不留尖锐石子。

name: 对鸣海豚
visual: a pearl white dolphin with two differently shaped echo fins
lore: 两片听鳍分别接收近处与远处的回声，从不把幼崽带进暗礁。

name: 双叶竹节
visual: a slim mint stick insect with two enormous paired leaf shields
lore: 前肢总向相反的方向展开，让雨水均匀地流进脚下的泥里。

name: 双炬萤虫
visual: a black firefly with two bright lantern pods on forked tail
lore: 两盏尾灯亮起的间隔就是它的名字，伙伴从不需要靠近确认。

name: 双环海蛇
visual: a white and navy sea snake coiled into two luminous floating rings
lore: 把身体盘成两个相连的圆，幼鱼可以从中穿过而不受急流冲击。

name: 卷芽穿山甲
visual: an olive pangolin with curled fern scales and a spiral bud tail
lore: 每片鳞甲下面都压着一小撮苔芽，卷起身体时便是一座会呼吸的花坛。

name: 螺烟蝾
visual: a black salamander with a spiral smoke chimney crest and orange feet
lore: 背上的烟囱只排出温暖的水雾，脚印旁很快就会长出耐热的青苔。

name: 涡壳鹦鹉螺
visual: a teal chambered nautilus with a thick white spiral shell and short tentacles
lore: 壳内不同的空室存着不同温度的水，潜深时会逐一交换。

name: 盘根树懒
visual: a green sloth hanging from its own curled root tail and branch arms
lore: 尾根能抓住看不见的细枝，动作虽慢，却从没让树上的果子提前落下。

name: 卷刃螳
visual: a rust mantis with two tightly curled sawblade forearms
lore: 镰臂不用时卷成圆环，只有风折断活枝时才会替树修整伤口。

name: 涡心海葵
visual: a rose sea anemone with a dark spiral center and flowing teal tentacles
lore: 触须围成一个缓慢旋转的圈，把不能食用的碎屑送回圈外。

name: 旋翅蜂鸟
visual: a tiny turquoise hummingbird with spiral translucent wings and long needle beak
lore: 悬停时翅尖像两个旋涡，总在同一朵花前留下第三次振翅的回声。

name: 盘香蜗
visual: a red snail with an incense coil shell emitting a soft golden wisp
lore: 壳上烟丝带着干草气味，走失的同伴会循着这道细线找到营地。

name: 旋涡魟
visual: a broad indigo stingray with a spiral tail and swirling white belly
lore: 用长尾在海底画出漩涡，沉下的贝壳会整齐停在圆心。

name: 帆叶豚
visual: a rounded green capybara with one enormous vertical banana leaf sail
lore: 不擅长奔跑，便借着背上的叶帆慢慢漂过河口。

name: 风炉蜥
visual: a low broad red frilled desert lizard with a huge circular orange bellows collar, short blunt face, sprawled four legs and curled thick tail
lore: 迎风展开颈边的风箱褶领给腹部火核送气，夜里则把褶领收紧保温。

name: 帆冰燕
visual: a blue white arctic tern with triangular icicle wings and forked tail
lore: 先把翅尖擦过浪面再起飞，冰屑会像细小的风标留在身后。

name: 舟叶蚱蜢
visual: a green grasshopper riding its own long boat shaped leaf abdomen
lore: 腹部像一艘窄舟，遇到积水便收起长腿，载着花粉漂到对岸。

name: 帆背棘龙
visual: a small burgundy spinosaurus with a huge amber translucent dorsal sail
lore: 背帆能透出琥珀色的光，幼体会躲在它投下的斑驳影子里午睡。

name: 浪裙海蛞蝓
visual: a white sea slug with a wide ruffled blue wave skirt and coral ears
lore: 裙边每次起伏都会送出一点清水，附近的海草因此长得格外整齐。

name: 风翼飞鼠
visual: a tiny grey flying squirrel with green membrane wings and flat leaf tail
lore: 飞膜上的浅色纹路记录树与树的距离，换季后会重新丈量整片树林。

name: 烛帆蝠
visual: a black bat with glowing orange translucent candle flame wings
lore: 翅膜的火纹不会发热，倒挂时把整座洞穴照成温柔的琥珀色。

name: 天幕鲸鲨
visual: a wide navy whale shark with a galaxy spotted canopy back
lore: 背部的星点会随着呼吸明灭，远看像一片缓缓卷起的夜空。

name: 月钩树蛙
visual: a mint tree frog with crescent suction pads and a curled moon leaf on its head
lore: 趾端的月钩能贴住最薄的叶子，夜风再大也不会惊醒叶背的虫。

name: 镰火鹭
visual: a tall crimson ibis with a glowing sickle bill and black legs
lore: 用弯喙捞起落水的火种，巢旁的浅滩因此总留着一点温暖。

name: 弧光电鳗
visual: a pale blue electric eel bent like a crescent with yellow current whiskers
lore: 胡须间的微光能勾出暗礁轮廓，它从不在拥挤的鱼群中放电。

name: 钩月羚
visual: a slender white antelope with a single huge crescent green horn
lore: 独角会接住顺风飘来的露珠，奔跑前先把它们抖落在脚边的草里。

name: 弯潮龙虾
visual: a dark green lobster with asymmetric crescent claws and a fan tail
lore: 一大一小的弯钳分别夹住岩面与食物，只有最安静的潮夜才会离巢。

name: 月牙翻车鱼
visual: a round silver sunfish with a giant crescent tail and pearl eye
lore: 圆圆的身体替近岸的小鱼挡住涌浪，转身时像月亮落进海面。

name: 月镰鹗
visual: a slate blue osprey with enormous crescent wing tips and white mask
lore: 把折断的羽尖留在航标旁，飞过的鸟就知道前方的海风有多强。

name: 弧翼蚕
visual: a tiny lime silk moth with two arch shaped emerald wings and fluffy collar
lore: 只在新月的夜里舒展弧翼，吐出的丝会在天亮前变成透明的绿。

name: 弯湾海牛
visual: a gentle lavender manatee with crescent flippers and curled whiskers
lore: 把腹下的暖水推向浅湾，迁徙时仍记得每一处曾休息过的海草床。
